name: WLF_LI_VIDEOS_F
description: Table to store of technical details of learning item of type videos.

columns.name: VIDEO_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: LEARNING_ITEM_ID
columns.description: LEARNING_ITEM_ID

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: CONTENT_ID

columns.name: VIDEO_MEDIA_STATUS
columns.description: VIDEO_MEDIA_STATUS

columns.name: THUMBNAIL_EXTRACTION_STATUS
columns.description: THUMBNAIL_EXTRACTION_STATUS

columns.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
columns.description: ENCRYPTION_KEY

columns.name: PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Transcoding provider identifier.

columns.name: FRAME_RATE
columns.description: Frame rate in fps of the video.

columns.name: FRAME_WIDTH
columns.description: Frame width in pixels of the video.

columns.name: FRAME_HEIGHT
columns.description: Frame height in pixels of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_CODEC
columns.description: Video codec of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_BITRATE
columns.description: Video bit-rate of the video.

columns.name: VIDEO_TRANSCODING_QUAL
columns.description: Video transcoding quality selector

columns.name: SCREEN_CAPTURE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the video mostly contains screen captures

columns.name: AUDIO_CODEC
columns.description: Audio codec of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_BITRATE
columns.description: Audio bit-rate in kbps of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_CHANNELS
columns.description: Number of audio channels of the video.

columns.name: AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE
columns.description: Audio sample rate in Hz of the video.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Original file name of video.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: STORAGE_LOCATION
columns.description: This column to store location of Storage server path where actual content (Video/Image) available

columns.name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
columns.description: This column represents Storage server name where  actual content (Video/Image) is stored. Example Akamai, UCM etc

columns.name: STREAMING_PROVIDER
columns.description: The stream packaging provider of the video.
